title: Agent Memory as a File Format Raises a Practical Question for AI Builders
dek: A widely discussed Hacker News link points to a deceptively operational idea: treating an agent’s memory as a portable file rather than an opaque byproduct of a model session.
socialCaption: Agent memory is increasingly an operational design problem. A Hacker News discussion around “Agent Memory as a File Format” puts the focus on portability, inspection, governance, and lifecycle control—not just longer context.
